output.sentence_text: In this GPT-2 example, the embedding size is 768, which is the size used in the smallest GPT-2 model.
Each token in the sequence is encoded as a 768-dimensional vector.
For each token, the token embedding can be visualized as a 768-dimensional vector, and positional embeddings can be visualized in the same way.
Token embedding vectors are not known in advance, so they are initialized randomly in the 768-dimensional space and learned during GPT model training along with the other embedding parameters.
In the example sequence, there are four positions, and position one, position two, position three, and position four are each represented by a 768-dimensional positional embedding vector.
The positional embedding vectors have size 768, the same size as the token embeddings.
Because token embeddings and positional embeddings have the same dimensions, each input embedding also has dimension 768.
